messages:
ara (People Ops): Heads up everyone 1 — mini-calibration sprint this week. Short timeline, so a few process tweaks to keep things moving.
ara (People Ops): High level: review forms due WED 11:59pm PT. Calibration sprint is THU (all slots 20m) and Fri morning (10m catchups). If you or a report are on PTO/LOA, file an exception by Tue EOD.
mike (People Ops): New: were introducing a rapid review tag for obvious high-performers or clear development-needed cases so calibrators can skip deep dives. Only use when manager_summary has at least 2 evidence bullets.
julia (Eng Manager): Quick question: for hires that started mid-cycle, should we rate pro-rata or mark too early?
ara (People Ops): @julia mark them as "limited-cycle-data" and provide the hire date + onboarding milestones in manager_summary. Well treat them separately during calibration (shorter discussion).
omar (IC): Can ICs edit self-assessments after manager submits? We noticed a typo.
mike (People Ops): IC edits: yes, until the review form deadline. After that, everything is locked until post-calibration. Recommend ICs make edits earlier to avoid divergence.
nina (Recruiting): For people who left this cycle but have exit notes, can managers attach exit summaries to the review form?
ara (People Ops): Yes, attach with filename: "exit-<last>-<first>.pdf". Add a one-line context in manager_summary.
julia (Eng Manager): About calibration slots  is there a hard cap per manager? We have 4 managers sharing 28 reports.
mike (People Ops): Default cap is 4 slots per manager. If your team needs more, add an overflow request in the sheet and well allocate floaters. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/mini-cal-sprint
ara (People Ops): CSV/import note: the import expects these headers exactly: reviewer, employee_email, manager_summary. Case-sensitive. If you hit an import error, include a screenshot in this thread and well triage.
julia (Eng Manager): Triage idea  can we batch similar cases (e.g., all ICs with meets expectations + no disciplinaries) into a single 10m slot to speed through?
ara (People Ops): Good idea. Tag those rows with "batchable" in the sheet and well let calibrators know. Keep at least one example doc per batch.
omar (IC): Whats the expected format for evidence bullets? Short one-liners or longer explanations?
mike (People Ops): Keep bullets concise: 1-2 lines each with a quant or observable outcome if possible. e.g., "Reduced mean inference latency 18% by kernel X" or "Led incident response for <prod> outage (3h)".
nina (Recruiting): Also remind managers to update org chart headcounts; cost center tags affect budgeting for leveling changes.
ara (People Ops): Well push a tiny calibration cheat sheet and a validator tool link in #review-ops by noon. Please check the validator before uploading.
ops-bot: Reminder: Review forms deadline in ~36 hours. Forms: https://app.redwood/reviews
julia (Eng Manager): Thanks team. Well use batching + overflow request.
omar (IC): Appreciated  small template helped.
ara (People Ops): Thanks all  if anything blocks you, ping @mike or me. Well be triaging requests through the sheet and the thread. :sparkles:
